<script>(function(){if(!/\/blog/i.test(location.pathname))return;var id='nifty-blog-grid-fix';var css=".nifty-bloglist:not(:has(> .nifty-bl-card)),.nifty-bg-wrap{display:block !important;width:auto !important;max-width:none !important;margin:0 !important}.nifty-bloglist:has(> .nifty-bl-card),.grid:has(> .card),.nifty-bg-cards{display:grid !important;grid-column:1/-1 !important;gap:28px !important;align-items:stretch !important;width:auto !important;max-width:none !important;grid-template-columns:repeat(1,1fr) !important}.nifty-bloglist>.nifty-bl-card,.grid>.card,.nifty-bg-cards>*{width:auto !important;max-width:none !important;margin:0 !important;float:none !important}@media(min-width:641px){.nifty-bloglist:has(> .nifty-bl-card),.grid:has(> .card),.nifty-bg-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr) !important}}@media(min-width:1025px){.nifty-bloglist:has(> .nifty-bl-card),.grid:has(> .card),.nifty-bg-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) !important}}";function inject(){if(!document.getElementById(id)){var el=document.createElement('style');el.id=id;el.textContent=css;(document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(el);}}function tag(){var cards=document.querySelectorAll('.nifty-bloglist>.nifty-bl-card,.grid>.card');var conts=[];for(var i=0;i<cards.length;i++){var p=cards[i].parentElement;if(p){p.classList.add('nifty-bg-cards');if(conts.indexOf(p)<0)conts.push(p);}}for(var c=0;c<conts.length;c++){var el=conts[c].parentElement,hops=0;while(el&&hops<6){var d=getComputedStyle(el).display;if(d.indexOf('grid')>=0&&el.children.length===1){el.classList.add('nifty-bg-wrap');el=el.parentElement;hops++;}else break;}}var bl=document.querySelectorAll('.nifty-bloglist');for(var j=0;j<bl.length;j++){if(!bl[j].classList.contains('nifty-bg-cards'))bl[j].classList.add('nifty-bg-wrap');}}function run(){inject();tag();}run();document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);window.addEventListener('load',run);})();</script>

<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.forms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'submit', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'click', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>
